messages:
AlexK: Heads-up — prepping the internal announce for tomorrow's micro-deploy of serving config. Need a short digest + pin guidance. Who can own the release-note blurb?
MariaG: I can take the blurb. What’s the cutoff for edits?
AlexK: Cutoff is 2pm PT today. Deploy window is 11pm–1am PT. Plan: canary 10% for first 20m, then 50% for 30m, then full. deploy-bot will post canary/ramp cues.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled deploy "micro-inference-config-v2" -> prod (canary plan attached). Command: `/deploy micro-inference-config-v2 --env prod --canary 10% --steps 20m,50%,30m`
SanjayR: Quick Q — do we need to pin the model version for this rollout? Current prod model is v1.4.2, this would introduce v1.5.0-quant. Fallback concerns (quant->fp16) if there are OOMs.
AlexK: Yes, pinning required. In RN we should include: `prod-serving: model: v1.5.0-quant; fallback: v1.4.2` plus rollback steps.
PriyaO: Oncall ack — I'll watch infra and business metrics. Please add alert thresholds: latency > 300ms OR error rate > 2% triggers immediate rollback evaluation.
MariaG: Draft blurb (WIP):
"Internal: rolling config to enable prefix caching and ship model v1.5.0-quant to prod. Expected latency decrease ~12–18%. Canary: 10% for 20m → 50% for 30m → 100%. Rollback: any increase in tail latency >15% or sustained error rate >1.5% for 2 consecutive mins. If OOMs occur, fallback automatically to v1.4.2 (fp16). Do NOT send external-facing comms; internal only (eng, product, support)."
AlexK: Nice. Shorten for the announcement header: "Cache on; model pinned v1.5.0-quant; canary 10%→50%→100%; rollback on errors or latency +15%." Keep the detailed steps in the RN doc.
SanjayR: Also add an ops note about quantization fallback path + manual pin command if needed: `deploy-bot pin model prod v1.5.0-quant` and rollback: `deploy-bot rollback micro-inference-config-v2 --to model v1.4.2`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started at 23:05 PT (10% traffic). Metrics: https://internal.metrics/redwood/deploys/8954321099 :eyes:
PriyaO: Seeing a small latency blip at t+5m, +8% p95. Still within tolerance. continuing monitoring.
AlexK: Keep watching. If latency rises >15% or errors exceed thresholds for 2 min, trigger rollback steps and ping #eng-oncall and product lead.
MariaG: I'll finalize RN and post to #eng-releases at 14:45 PT with the blurb and the expanded rollback/runbook. Draft below (will edit then post):
---
Internal release (prod) — micro-inference-config-v2
- What: Enable prefix cache for embeddings + update model to v1.5.0-quant (pin).
- Why: ~12–18% expected latency improvement and lower token cost.
- Canary plan: 10% (20m) → 50% (30m) → 100%
- Rollback triggers: tail latency increase >15% OR error rate >1.5% sustained for 2 mins / OOM detected.
- Rollback steps: 
  1) `deploy-bot rollback micro-inference-config-v2 --to-model v1.4.2`
  2) monitor metrics for 10m, escalate to infra if unstable.
- Audience: eng, product, support (internal only).
---
AlexK: :thumbsup: Add a short line telling CS to hold external comms until we confirm stable.
SanjayR: Confirm the smart-routing policy `canary-fallback-quant` is attached so traffic can be routed away if issues surface.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramp step executed — canary moved to 50% traffic as of 23:30 PT.
PriyaO: Metrics stable after ramp, error rate 0.2%, p95 down ~10% from baseline. No action.
AlexK: Post-deploy checklist for tomorrow morning: update release-notes entry in docs, add a console dashboard snippet showing the model pin and canary timeline, and send an internal blast to product & CS at 09:00 PT summarizing outcome.
MariaG: Will post RN to #eng-releases at 14:45 PT and tag product/CS leads. I'll include the metrics link and the rollback runbook. Thanks all.
AlexK: Thanks team — I'll close the thread once the RN is posted.
